## Purpose
Full-screen error view that renders an HTTP-style status, title and subtitle from a `CustomError` object. It is shown by the app when loading config or GitHub data fails. Purely presentational, with decorative background circles.

## Key concepts
- `ErrorPage` is a `React.FC<CustomError>` taking `status`, `title`, `subTitle` props; the type comes from [[src-constants]] (`constants/errors`).
- Styled with daisyUI/Tailwind theme classes (`bg-base-200`, `text-primary`).
